meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会在你问过去会话的事时,去查 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库并作答。它走分层流程:搜索索引 → 时间线看上下文 → 取指定条目详情 →(很少用到)取原始工具记录,先过滤再取全文以省 token。
howto.when: 当你问的是过去会话(不是当前对话)时触发,比如「这个是不是已经修过」「上次 X 怎么做的」「上周发生了什么」之类的问题。

say.text: 上周那个登录问题我们修好了吗?
say.note: 会先搜索索引,再按时间线给出上下文
先搜索,再取相关条目的完整详情

say.text: 把 #11131 这条的完整详情取出来
say.note: 返回该条观察的完整记录

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory database when you ask about past sessions. It uses a layered flow — search index, timeline, fetch details, rarely raw tool I/O — filtering before fetching to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, not the current conversation — e.g. "did we already fix this?", "how did we solve X last time?", or "what happened last week?".

say_en.text: Did we already fix the login issue last week?
say_en.note: Searches the index, then shows timeline context

say_en.text: How did we set up authentication last time?
